consequence.statement: New optional annotation; no operational consequence if the operator does nothing.

original.statement: A new pod annotation `sidecar.istio.io/native-side` (true/false) was added to control native sidecar injection per pod, taking precedence over ENABLE_NATIVE_SIDECARS.

decision.reason: [ev-528ec6ff2f80] describes a newly **Added** per-pod annotation that users "can" set to true or false. It only takes precedence over ENABLE_NATIVE_SIDECARS when someone sets it. The evidence names nothing that fails, changes default behaviour or must be done when the annotation is absent, so an operator who does nothing sees no change. Kind "none" with the informational class is supported.
